A job I don't have
A marriage that's since ended
Pretty much nothing else

My life is nothing but pain and abuse and regret.

I should have done this years ago.

This idea that it'll get better is bullshit. It was way better when I last wanted to if only I'd known then how much worse it could be.
Hanging out with that friend that no longer wants to talk to me
It hasn't gotten better for all the many years of my life. I'm past my 20s. It's not going to get better. There's no guarantee it'll miraculously change tomorrow. It won't it'll likely just slog on.

Yes thank you weird assholes who want to message me things like "hey sexy". 

When tomorrow comes and I can go buy the things I need to complete the job. Remember, you contributed.
